name: Tadalafil
summary: A prescription PDE5-inhibitor pill for erectile dysfunction and for urinary symptoms of an enlarged prostate; in trials, its effect on erections lasted up to 36 hours.
what_it_is: Tadalafil is a phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitor. During sexual stimulation, nerves and blood vessel linings release nitric oxide, which raises cGMP and relaxes smooth muscle so blood flows into the penis; blocking PDE5 keeps cGMP higher, so tadalafil has no effect without sexual stimulation. The same drug is sold as Adcirca for pulmonary arterial hypertension, and the two should not be taken together.

evidence.why: FDA-approved for erectile dysfunction and for urinary symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia based on randomized trials; AUA guidelines recommend PDE5 inhibitors for ED and list tadalafil as an option for these urinary symptoms.

status_us.label: FDA-approved for ED and enlarged-prostate symptoms
status_us.note: Approved for erectile dysfunction, the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), and both together. Tadalafil is also sold as Adcirca for pulmonary arterial hypertension.

benefits.claim: Improved erections in men with erectile dysfunction: in two US trials, successful intercourse attempts rose to 50% and 64% versus 25% and 23% on placebo, with effects lasting up to 36 hours
Improved erectile function compared with placebo in 216 men with type 1 or type 2 diabetes
Treats urinary symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia, with or without erectile dysfunction; the AUA lists it as a treatment option
In men with ED and low testosterone, PDE5 inhibitors may work better when combined with testosterone therapy (AUA; low-certainty evidence)

risks.risk: Headache (about 11% to 15% versus 5% on placebo), indigestion, back pain, muscle aches, nasal congestion, flushing and limb pain
Severe drop in blood pressure if combined with nitrates or riociguat; added blood pressure lowering with alpha-blockers, other blood pressure drugs and heavy drinking
Erection lasting more than 4 hours (priapism), which needs emergency care
Sudden vision loss from NAION (damage to the optic nerve), reported rarely; sudden hearing loss has also been reported, though a causal link is not established
Serious skin reactions, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome and exfoliative dermatitis, have been reported

avoid_if: Taking nitrates in any form, regularly or now and then
Taking riociguat or another guanylate cyclase stimulator
Heart conditions that make sexual activity unsafe, such as unstable angina or uncontrolled arrhythmia or blood pressure
Past serious allergic reaction to tadalafil
interactions: Nitrates: contraindicated; if a nitrate is needed in a life-threatening emergency, the label says at least 48 hours should pass after the last tadalafil dose, with close monitoring
Alpha-blockers (such as doxazosin, tamsulosin or alfuzosin) and other blood pressure drugs: extra blood pressure lowering; for BPH, combining with an alpha-blocker is not recommended
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, ritonavir, itraconazole; grapefruit juice likely): raise tadalafil levels
CYP3A4 inducers such as rifampin: sharply lower tadalafil levels
Other PDE5 inhibitors, including Adcirca: not to be combined

before: Morning total testosterone if low testosterone is suspected
labs.why: The label sets no routine lab tests; the AUA notes that erectile dysfunction can be a marker of underlying heart disease and that PDE5 inhibitors may work better when low testosterone is treated.

studies.title: Erectile Dysfunction: AUA Guideline
studies.finding: Recommends telling men with ED about PDE5 inhibitors, finds sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil and avanafil similarly effective, and says men taking nitrates regularly should not use them.

studies.title: Management of Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Attributed to Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: AUA Guideline
studies.people: Men with urinary symptoms from an enlarged prostate
studies.finding: Tadalafil should be discussed as an option whether or not a man has erectile dysfunction; combining it with an alpha-blocker adds no symptom benefit over either drug alone.

studies.title: CIALIS (tadalafil) tablets: Prescribing Information
studies.people: Men with erectile dysfunction in two US trials, and 216 men with diabetes
studies.finding: Tadalafil raised the share of successful intercourse attempts versus placebo, with effects up to 36 hours after taking it.

ask_your_clinician: Is my heart healthy enough for sexual activity, and could my ED be an early sign of heart disease?
Do any of my medicines, including nitrates, alpha-blockers or other blood pressure drugs, interact with tadalafil?

sources.title: Management of Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Attributed to Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: AUA Guideline (amended 2021)
Erectile Dysfunction: AUA Guideline
sources.publisher: Journal of Urology (American Urological Association PDF)

notes_for_editor: Label is the March 2026 Cialis label as reprinted by Drugs.com. The BPH trial results (symptom-score changes) were in a part of the page that could not be read, so the BPH benefit rests on the approved indication and the AUA guideline. That Adcirca treats pulmonary arterial hypertension comes from Drugs.com's related-drugs text; the label itself only says not to combine Cialis with Adcirca. Off-label uses such as daily use for general blood flow or exercise were not reviewed.
